intro: This feed is updated with each release so players can quickly see what changed.

notes: MAJOR = breaking player-facing structure or progression resets.
MINOR = new features/content visible to players.
PATCH = fixes, balancing, and polish with no major feature rollout.
Optional -tag for pre-release or rollout labels.

player_update_criteria: Gameplay, progression, economy, or reward behavior changed.
Menus, UX flows, or social systems players directly use changed.
New or updated content/events/decor/recipes visible in game.
internal_update_criteria: Dev tooling, refactor, test harness, infra, or cleanup only.
No player-visible behavior change in normal gameplay.
